evidence.observation: Pressure steady near 3.02-3.04 Torr through ramp and early growth
Pressure rose steadily from 3.04 to 3.48 Torr over 600 s of growth
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the flow did not cause the pressure rise
Temperature holding at 750 C, heater power stable
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; the growth-stage atmosphere cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading or a leak-up/rate-of-rise test to tell air getting in through a seal leak apart from exhaust/pump restriction; also operator verification of the atmosphere, since the required O2 sensor is absent.
